Ben/Lauren — Deal Desk triage here. Short answers:
- Threshold: standard delegated approval is up to 8–12% depending on term/market. Anything above 12% requires finance and Sales leadership sign-off and a documented commercial rationale (strategic value, expansion runway, reference value).
- Paperwork: please resubmit the pricing worksheet with the proposed concession highlighted and provide 2 comparables (recent deals in healthcare or similar ARR/seat profiles). Attach the requested MOA when available.

Forecast guidance: do NOT mark this as "Commit" in the forecast until we have 1) Deal Desk approval on concession AND 2) the countersigned MOA. For the upcoming close, move the stage to "Commit - Pricing Approval" or "Commit (contingent)" so Finance can exclude it from the firm committed number if needed.

I'll triage ASAP once Ben resubmits; if it's within 12% we can clear it EOD, otherwise we'll need a quick finance check.

—Karthik
